guide.politicsmod.page.1:
§lPoliticsMod§r

Found a nation, build cities, earn money and deal with your neighbours.

Press §lK§r to open your country's dashboard.

/politicsmod help lists all commands.
guide.politicsmod.page.2:
§lFounding a country§r

Craft a Founding Stone, place it and right-click it to name your country.

You get 5×5 chunks around the stone. They must not belong to anyone.
guide.politicsmod.page.3:
§lCities§r

Place a City Stone on your land and name the city. It covers the chunks around it that you own.

A city has its own treasury and can get a mayor.
guide.politicsmod.page.4:
§lTerritory§r

On the Map tab, select chunks and claim them for the country or a city.

Land gets dearer as the country grows, and chunks not touching it cost more. Upkeep is paid every cycle; the capital core is free.
guide.politicsmod.page.5:
§lRoles§r

§lLeader§r: everything.
§lMayor§r: invites, cities, plots.
§lCitizen§r: builds on free land.

Manage people on the Citizens tab.
guide.politicsmod.page.6:
§lTreasury§r

The treasury pays for land, war and salaries.

Tax Blocks earn income every cycle, Vaults raise the treasury limit.

See the Economy tab.

Every morning the country gets a report on the past day in chat.
guide.politicsmod.page.7:
§lWallet§r

Your own money:
/politicsmod wallet

The leader can pay you a salary from the treasury. Part of salaries and sales returns as income tax.
guide.politicsmod.page.8:
§lExchange§r

Right-click a Vault with the exchange currency (emeralds by default) to turn it into money.

Or:
/politicsmod wallet exchange
guide.politicsmod.page.9:
§lMarket§r

A Trade Warehouse opens the market of all nations.

Sell the item in your hand, buy with your wallet or the treasury.

No trade during war.
guide.politicsmod.page.10:
§lPlots§r

Mayors turn city chunks into plots to sell or rent.

Only the owner and trusted players can build there.

/politicsmod plot
guide.politicsmod.page.11:
§lProtection§r

Map tab, then Protection: choose what is allowed on your land.

PvP, explosions, fire, item pickup, entry of strangers. Each city can differ.
guide.politicsmod.page.12:
§lWar§r

War costs money. To take land, start a siege in an enemy border chunk: /politicsmod siege start

Keep more fighters there than the defenders until the bar fills. The loser may surrender and pay tribute.
guide.politicsmod.page.13:
§lBuildings§r

§lEmbassy§r: income from a partner.
§lRadar§r: warns about enemies.
§lResidential Building§r: population.
§lVault§r: bigger treasury.
§lFlagpole§r: flies the flag of the land's owner.
guide.politicsmod.page.14:
§lElections and laws§r

The leader calls elections for leader or mayor; citizens run and vote. A petition signed by half the citizens forces a leader election.

Laws: closed borders, martial law, free trade.

§lDebt§r

The treasury can fall below zero. A bankrupt country can't wage war, and its mayors may secede.

Allies can lend money:
/politicsmod loan
